title.zh: Crypto.com旗下OG.com获SEC确认可提供单只股票期货
title.en: Crypto.com's OG.com Cleared by SEC to Offer Single-Stock Futures

current_state.zh: OG.com, the sister futures exchange of Crypto.com, received SEC acknowledgement of its 1-N filing to list single-stock futures in the US, with plans to work with the CFTC on single-stock perpetuals.
current_state.en: OG.com, the sister futures exchange of Crypto.com, received SEC acknowledgement of its 1-N filing to list single-stock futures in the US, with plans to work with the CFTC on single-stock perpetuals.
